required_mounts.go_toolchain: the Go install, what `go env GOROOT` prints -- it must be a Linux build for this machine's architecture, so on macOS put one in ~/.box/deps/ and point here instead
required_mounts.go_mod_cache: the Go module cache, what `go env GOMODCACHE` prints -- read-only; box itself needs nothing from it, but the toolchain wants somewhere to look
